;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] (TPLF) launches a [[4 November Northern Command attacks|surprise attack on the Northern Command]] of the  [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|federal army]] of [[Ethiopia]], resulting in multiple casualties and the capture of 5 federal military bases in [[Tigray Region]] including the Northern Command headquarters. [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] orders a military response, saying that the "last red line has been crossed". Later in the day, federal troops enter the region and heavy fighting is reported. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-954805088 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/ethiopia-sends-army-into-tigray-region-heavy-fighting-reported-idUSKBN27K0ZS?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Eta]] is set to head towards Florida after hitting the [[Caribbean]] and [[Central America]], especially [[Nicaragua]] and parts of [[Honduras]]. The slow-moving [[category 4 hurricane|hurricane, which peaked at category 4]], caused floods and devastation in Nicaragua and hurricane warnings are still in place for parts of Nicaragua. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/04/weather/hurricane-eta-wednesday/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports 6,211 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://kurier.at/chronik/oesterreich/6211-neue-corona-infektionen-in-oesterreich/401086881 (''Kurier'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[President of Cyprus|President]] [[Nicos Anastasiades]] announce a curfew from 11:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time and orders bars, cafés, restaurants and cultural venues to close at 10:30 p.m. beginning November 6 and until the end of this month. [https://www.politico.eu/article/cyprus-brings-in-new-coronavirus-measures-including-curfew/ (''Politico'')]  
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Prime Minister of Denmark|Prime Minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] announces the extermination of the country's [[mink]]s (around 15 million) after a mutated version of the [[coronavirus]] spreads to humans, reasoning mutations pose a risk to the efficacy of future [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s. [https://www.dw.com/en/denmark-to-cull-all-farmed-minks-over-coronavirus-mutation/a-55501832 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 2,646 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day record since the pandemic began and bringing the nationwide total to 46,892. [https://www.thenationalherald.com/archive_general_news_greece/arthro/greek_coronavirus_cases_spike_to_2_646_on_wednesday-1143126/ (''The National Herald'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Hungary)|Foreign Minister]] [[Péter Szijjártó]] tests positive for COVID-19 after arriving in [[Thailand]] for an official visit. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/hungary-foreign-minister-positive-covid-19-thailand-13463106 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Italy]]
****A new lockdown is announced for four [[Italian regions]]: [[Lombardy]], [[Piedmont]], [[Aosta Valley]], and [[Calabria]]. In two other regions, [[Apulia]] and [[Sicily]], stricter measures will be imposed. The measures will start on November 6. [https://www.corriere.it/cronache/20_novembre_04/dpcm-lockdown-lombardia-piemonte-calabria-valle-d-aosta-ecco-regioni-zona-rossa-arancione-cosa-si-puo-fare-be0dae60-1eba-11eb-9970-42ca5768e0fd.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
****[[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] also signs a decree that would impose a nationwide curfew from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time beginning tomorrow. Under new nationwide restrictions, museums will be closed and shopping centers will close on the weekend. [https://www.corriere.it/cronache/20_novembre_03/nuovo-dpcm-oggi-coprifuoco-32c653a6-1dc1-11eb-9970-42ca5768e0fd.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Lithuania]] declares a three-week [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] starting from November 7 to curb the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-lithuania/update-1-lithuania-to-enter-three-week-covid-lockdown-on-saturday-idINL8N2HQ525 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports 24,692 new infections and 373 deaths in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day record of both cases and deaths since the pandemic began. [https://tvn24.pl/polska/koronawirus-w-polsce-nowe-przypadki-zakazenia-i-smierci-4-listopada-2020-4741648 (TVN24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports 19,768 new infections and 389 deaths in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day record of both cases and deaths since the pandemic began, bringing the nationwide totals to 1,693,454 cases and 29,217 deaths. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/11/04/russia-breaks-coronavirus-cases-and-deaths-records-surges-past-19k-infections-a71953 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***The [[Philippines]] records 987 new infections in the past 24 hours, the lowest single-day record since July 14, bringing the total to 388,137. The lowest figure is attributed to the 12 testing laboratories that failed to submit their reports on time. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/11/04/20/ph-records-987-new-covid-19-cases-lowest-single-day-tally-since-july-14 (ABS-CBN)] [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2020/11/4/PH-987-new-coronavirus-cases.html (CNN Philippines)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]] reports 5,745 new infections and 82 deaths in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day record of both cases and deaths since the pandemic began, bringing the nationwide totals to 235,310 cases and 3,982 deaths. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/morocco-records-highest-single-day-virus-cases-deaths/2032383# (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] reports 4,101 new cases of COVID-19, a new single-day record. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/2020/11/04/michigan-coronavirus-cases-up-to-192096-death-toll-now-at-7419/ (WDIV-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Novavax]] signs an agreement with the [[Australian Government|Australian government]] to supply 40 million doses of their NVX-CoV2373 vaccine candidate to the [[Australia|country]] during the first half of 2021. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-australia-novavax-idUSKBN27K21P (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement]]
**The [[United States]] officially withdraws from the [[Paris Agreement]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-54797743 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Minister of the Interior (France)|French Interior Minister]] [[Gérald Darmanin]] declares that the [[Turkey|Turkish]] ultranationalist group [[Grey Wolves (organization)|Grey Wolves]] has been outlawed, stating they "[incite] discrimination and hatred and [are] involved in violent actions". The decision follows a string of high-profile attacks against the [[Armenia]]n community in [[Lyon]] in recent weeks that have been attributed to the group. [https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2020/11/04/en-france-le-mouvement-ultranationaliste-turc-des-loups-gris-officiellement-dissous_6058483_823448.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[War crimes in the Kosovo War]]
**Former [[President of Kosovo]] and [[Kosovo Liberation Army]] spokesman [[Jakup Krasniqi]] is transferred to the [[Kosovo Specialist Chambers and Specialist Prosecutor's Office|Kosovo Specialist Chambers]] in the [[The Hague]] to face trial on charges of [[war crime]]s and [[crimes against humanity]] during the [[Kosovo War]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kosovo-warcrimes/kosovo-war-crimes-suspect-krasniqi-transferred-to-the-hague-idUSKBN27K2UQ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States elections]]
**[[2020 United States presidential election]]
***The outcome of the 2020 United States presidential election is still undetermined. Incumbent [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] declares victory despite not reaching the required 270 [[United States Electoral College|electoral votes]] needed to win. Former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]], having more projected electoral votes, says, "We're on track to win this election." Trump has sued in several states, claiming, without providing evidence, widespread [[voter fraud]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2020/nov/03/us-election-2020-live-updates-president-donald-trump-joe-biden-latest-presidential-election-news-polls-update (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/11/02/trump-lawyers-election-biden-pennsylvania/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[2020 United States election protests]]
***Protesters took to the streets for a second night in a row as the presidential election inched closer to results. Protests and marches were underway in cities such as [[Philadelphia]], [[Detroit]] and [[Chicago]]. The [[National Guard]] was mobilized in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]] and arrests were made in [[Minneapolis]] and [[New York City]], with police confiscating weapons.  [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/11/04/election-unrest-hundreds-march-several-arrested-protests-continue/6158310002/  (''USA Today'')]
**[[2020 Puerto Rican status referendum]]
***In a nonbinding resolution, 52% of [[Puerto Ricans]] vote to make [[Puerto Rico|the island]] into [[Statehood movement in Puerto Rico|a U.S. state]]. [https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2020/11/4/21536603/puerto-rico-status-referendum-statehood-results (''Vox'')]

;Science and technology
*[[SGR 1935+2154]]
**[[Astronomer]]s announce the discovery of [[SGR 1935+2154|the first]] [[fast radio burst]] (FRB) signal detected in the [[Milky Way]] galaxy. The signal is believed to be coming from a [[magnetar]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/radio-burst-fast-galaxy-milky-way-b1590956.html?utm_content=Echobox&utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Facebook&fbclid=IwAR1tCpPDx3BmqDvadoPqeoaE-x1x1hjpWciHej_tABqlMNRC0Tzr7urnKl8#Echobox=1604505591 (''The Independent'')]
